articles.title: Timeouts, Retries, and Backoff with Jitter in Distributed Systems
articles.summary: Empirical simulation proving why AWS Full Jitter cuts retry storm server load by >40% compared to unjittered exponential backoff and Equal Jitter during recovery waves.
articles.whyItMatters: Directly validates our Bounded Ring Buffer + Full Jitter invariant in Chapter 1 of System Design.

articles.title: How Consistent Hashing Rings & Virtual Nodes Route Millions of Concurrent Sessions
articles.summary: Deep dive into how virtual nodes (vnodes) prevent cascading hot-spot failovers when stateful worker nodes join or leave high-throughput clusters.
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates why skipping same-physical-host virtual nodes is mandatory for R=3 fault-tolerant replication.

articles.title: Zero-Data-Loss Event Streaming with Transactional Outbox and Postgres WAL CDC
articles.summary: Eliminating dual-write race conditions between microservices and Kafka by tailing the relational Write-Ahead Log and enforcing idempotent consumer watermarks.
articles.whyItMatters: Pairs directly with our Kafka Outbox & Causal Offset Watermark textbook chapter and interactive simulator.

articles.title: Contextual Retrieval, Claim Entailment & Catching Subtle RAG Hallucinations
articles.summary: Why dense cosine similarity misses negation inversions and how combining BM25 + dense embeddings + per-claim entailment verification reduces retrieval failure rates by 67%.
articles.whyItMatters: Anchors Volume II Chapter 1 (The RAG Evaluation Triad & Negation Polarity Guard).

articles.title: Building Deterministic Guardrails and Regression Evals for Production AI Agents
articles.summary: Practical patterns for testing non-deterministic LLM pipelines in CI using deterministic claim decomposition, schema validation, and golden retrieval datasets.
articles.whyItMatters: Shows how Staff AI Engineers keep CI fast and deterministic while auditing LLM outputs.

articles.title: Role-Based Accessibility Trees & Resilient DOM Locators over CDP WebSockets
articles.summary: Why WAI-ARIA role and accessible-name locators outlive CSS refactors, and how Playwright multiplexes browser context commands over persistent CDP WebSocket pipes.
articles.whyItMatters: Connects Self-Healing DOM Confidence scoring with HTTP/2 & WebSocket transport internals.

articles.title: Inside TLS 1.3 1-RTT Handshakes, SYN Backlog Tuning & HTTP/2 Multiplexing at Edge Scale
articles.summary: Packet-by-packet breakdown of how TLS 1.3 saves a full round-trip time via early ECDHE key shares and why TCP-layer Head-of-Line blocking occurs on lossy networks.
articles.whyItMatters: Real-world kernel & edge telemetry matching our Core CS Chapter 2 interactive handshake simulator.

articles.title: Diagnosing Container OOMKills (Exit 137): Post-GC Trough Regression vs. Off-Heap Native Leaks
articles.summary: Why managed heap graphs look flat while Linux cgroup RSS climbs to OOM, and how OLS linear regression on post-GC minima catches leaks hours before crash.
articles.whyItMatters: Directly mirrors our OS Virtual Memory, Post-GC RSS Slope & File Descriptor Leak textbook chapter.

articles.title: B+Trees vs. LSM-Trees: Write Amplification, Bloom Filters & SQLite WAL Concurrency
articles.summary: Comparing page-based B+Trees with append-only LSM-Trees, Tombstone compaction, and how Write-Ahead Logging unlocks non-blocking concurrent readers.
articles.whyItMatters: Explains the exact storage engine architecture powering both RocksDB and this Hub's own SQLite WAL + FTS5 database!
